relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: It was in Calcutta, in 1880, that I first met Charles Henry Tawney, who was then Principal of the Sanskrit College

relations.subject: George A. Grierson
relations.evidence: recollections of a cordial friendship extending over more than forty years. It was in Calcutta, in 1880, that I first met Charles Henry Tawney... till his lamented death two years ago

relations.subject: L. D. Barnett
relations.role: proofreader and translator of revised passages
relations.evidence: Dr L. D. Barnett has again read through all my proofs, and has not only given me the advantage of his inexhaustible store of Sanskrit knowledge, but has translated afresh those passages which needed revision
